text:
maya (prod): quick sync — we need a final decision on response schema and minimal fields for the next API rollout. two customer asks (finreg audit logs + high-volume PLG): how we surface token usage, trace ids, and embeddings metadata. planning call tomorrow; want a short checklist now.

kevin (eng-api): +1. proposal: single top-level "usage" object with stable keys: prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens. keep field names short and non-nested for easy billing parsing.

anya (ml): for embeddings we should include vector_length and vector_norm (float) in metadata. customers asked for quick similarity debugging — norm helps. also suggest "embedding_model" string and "indexing_hint" optional.

sam (devex): SDK break concern — if we change names we need a compatibility shim for one release. prefer additive: accept both "usage" and legacy "token_counts" for 3 months, log a warning.

zhao (eng-runtime): runtime constraints: adding per-token breakdown increases payload size when streaming; keep usage summary top-level and detailed per-chunk optional. also we need a consistent trace header we can propagate across services. my vote: header "x-rw-trace-id" and response metadata field "trace_id" (uuid v4).

kevin (eng-api): agree on dual support shim. syntax suggestion for response (minimal):
```json
{
  "id": "resp_...",
  "object": "chat.completion",
  "created": 1710000000,
  "model": "redwood-chat-v1",
  "choices": [ { "index": 0, "message": { "role": "assistant", "content": "..." } } ],
  "usage": { "prompt_tokens": 12, "completion_tokens": 24, "total_tokens": 36 },
  "trace_id": "xxxxxxxx-xxxx-4xxx-yxxx-xxxxxxxxxxxx"
}
```

anya (ml): for embeddings response (minimal):
```json
{
  "id": "emb_...",
  "object": "embedding",
  "model": "embed-small-v1",
  "embedding": [0.001, -0.23, ...],
  "metadata": { "vector_length": 1536, "vector_norm": 12.4, "embedding_model": "embed-small-v1" },
  "usage": { "input_tokens": 8 },
  "trace_id": "..."
}
```

maya (prod): launch checklist (for tomorrow's decision):
- must-have: choose canonical field names for token usage (usage.prompt_tokens etc.)
- must-have: trace header name and response trace_id
- should-have: embeddings metadata (vector_length, vector_norm)
- should-have: compatibility shim for legacy key names
- stretch: structured per-token costs in API response (defer)

sam (devex): also add migration note to SDK changelog + quick snippet for customers: how to map legacy fields.

zhao (eng-runtime): ops note: we will sample and redact metadata for PII automatically; add a short config flag for customers to opt-in full metadata in Private deployments.

kevin (eng-api): decision call: if everyone OK, i'll open an RFC PR with the exact names and example payloads + deprecation policy.

maya (prod): @kevin please add the priority tags in the RFC (must/should/stretch) and include an exportable json-schema for QA. i'll take stakeholder sign-off after RFC. thanks all :thumbsup:

infra-bot: scheduled reminder: Product decision meeting in 12 hours (link: https://meet.redwood.dev/agenda).
